name: RadioGroup
intent: Pick exactly one option from a short visible list. One piece: legend, options, message.
usage: Use RadioGroup for one choice from two to six options that should stay visible, like a billing cycle. Use Checkbox for independent yes/no choices. The legend names the group; hide it only when a heading already names it. Card layout suits choices that need a description. See contracts/radiogroup.json for the full contract.

size.note: Circle 16 / 20 / 24 px, labels 12 / 14 / 16 px. Without a size it is md. A surrounding Density changes these sizes through the density tokens (Default values shown).

orientation.note: Horizontal only for two or three short labels. Card layout is always vertical.

layout.note: card = bordered rows, radio on the right, optional description and Badge.

hideLegend.note: Keeps the legend for screen readers, hides it on screen.

name.note: Optional. A name is generated when omitted.

error.note: Message under the group. Tints the radios red.

hint.note: Help text under the group. error replaces it.

options.note: Two to six. description and badge show in card layout.

useWhen: One choice from two to six visible options.
Settings where people compare options side by side.
doNot: Do not invent a Radio, RadioItem or RadioLegend cousin.
Do not use for independent yes/no choices. Use Checkbox.
Do not use for long lists of options.
Do not use to switch page panels.
Do not use an unstyled native radio.
a11y: fieldset with a legend that names the group.
Each option is a native input type=radio with a visible label; arrow keys move between options.
error sets aria-invalid on the fieldset and links the message with aria-describedby.
Disabled options stay readable but cannot be picked.
Focus ring on the circle for keyboard users.
snippet: <RadioGroup legend="Billing cycle" defaultValue="annual" options={[{ value: "monthly", label: "Monthly" }, { value: "annual", label: "Annual" }]} />

examples.title: Sizes
examples.usage: lg for a main decision, md for most forms, sm in dense filters and side panels.

examples.title: Horizontal
examples.usage: For two or three short labels in one row.

examples.title: Card
examples.usage: Bordered rows with the radio on the right. Use when each choice needs a short description or a Badge.

examples.title: Error and hint
examples.usage: Show error on the group when a required choice is empty or not allowed. Keep the message specific. Use hint for help text.

props.error: Select a billing cycle to continue.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.usage: Disable one option when it is not available for this account, or the whole group when a permission locks the choice.
